about_the_game:
⌬This game is specially prepared for those who are unable to purchase Snow x Hime⌬

 

The story follows a sword maiden filled with chivalry—mature, alluring, and graceful. Her blade is slender, perfectly mirroring her aura, weaving passion and romance into poetry. Her fragile figure strides across the battlefield, standing against countless foes, where blood blossoms like roses. She is a rose of war—breathtakingly beautiful, yet her thorns leave scars on those who dare to draw near, scattering like cherry blossoms in the wind.

 

Her name is Yuki-hime.

 

Frozen are not only time, but also her memories and past. Snow quietly blankets everything, even the faintest breath feels sealed in ice. She stands alone in endless mist, as if the world has reduced to just her—while the people, places, and moments once by her side have all turned into transparent ice sculptures, imprisoned in silent eternity. She reaches out to touch the frost, almost sensing warmth long gone, only to feel it turn into biting cold that buries her remaining hope layer by layer.

 

On this battlefield of ice and snow, Yuki-hime’s sword dances cold and elegant. Her blade, like her heart, long silent, still burns with one last ember of justice. Cold and heat intertwine, cruelty and romance collide—she is the solitary rose blooming in snow: impossible to face directly, impossible to forget.

 

 

A Pure Boss-Fight Action Game

No mobs. No dungeons. Only a series of unique boss battles.

Defeat them through blocking, dodging, counterattacks, perfect parries, stagger breaks, combos, and executions. Unlock new outfits along the way and uncover the truth behind the story.

 

 

Core Gameplay

Pure Boss Battles: Jump straight into the fight, focusing entirely on reading attacks and reacting with timing.

Every Boss Is Unique: Distinct weapons, movesets, and combat rhythms—adapt and find your strategy.

High-Intensity Combat System:

Block / Dodge: The foundation of survival.

Counterattack / Perfect Parry: Turn the tide with precision timing.

Stagger → Combo → Execution: Break their guard, unleash offense, and finish the fight.

Characters & Unlocks

Alluring Female Bosses: Each with her own unique appearance and personality.

Multiple Outfits: Defeat bosses to earn new costumes and customize looks.

Memory Shards: Every victory grants a shard, gradually revealing the full story and the truth behind the trial.

What You’ll Experience

Clear, rewarding progression: learn moves → stagger break → execution → unlock outfits and memories.

A stable challenge curve, with every battle refreshed by new weapons, moves, and rhythms.

If you enjoy action games that reward reading enemy patterns, mastering timing, and relying on pure skill to win—this is the one made for you.
